text:
jun park: Heads up  quick design sync on the sidebar regroup and permalink behavior. I'm trying a compact group pattern where Models + Endpoints live under a single parent row with a disclosure chevron. Goals: preserve existing public links, keep query/hash intact, and make deep-link arrivals obvious but not disruptive. Prototype: https://sketch.redwood/compact-group-v3

elaine wu: Love the compact parent. Two microcopy asks: 1) use sentence case for the header: 'Serving and endpoints' 2) the global sidebar toggle should be aria-label='Hide navigation' (not just 'Collapse').

mike cole: Routing plan: middleware will detect legacy paths and rewrite to canonical URLs. For server hits we'll 301 to the canonical + original search/hash. For in-app navigation we'll replaceState to avoid extra history entries. Pseudo: 
```n
if (legacy(path)) { 
  target = map[path]
  // server: redirect(301, target + search + hash)
  // client: history.replaceState({}, '', target + search + hash)
}
```

samir (sam): a11y checklist: aria-expanded on the group chevron, aria-controls set to the child list id, breadcrumb updates announced via aria-live='polite'. When a deep link targets a panel, move focus to the panel header and not into the body. Also do not auto-open very long panels on arrival.

maya singh: UX nit: show a subtle 'From docs' or 'From support' pill on arrival that can be dismissed. Keep it small and not modal.

jun park: agree. Also want a small 'why was I redirected?' hover for power users that explains legacy -> canonical mapping. Keep it in a help modal, not forced.

elaine wu: about the collapsed breadcrumb middle: use an ellipsis button with aria-label='Expand path'. When expanded, the list should be keyboard navigable and first item receives focus. Add reduced-motion support for expand animation.

mike cole: infra will add an X-Original-Path header on server redirects so the client can show that help state without an extra lookup. I'll file PLAT-4510 for redirect table + shim + telemetry.

samir (sam): test cases I'll own: 1) legacy URL with ?tab and #fragment lands and preserves both 2) ellipsis button keyboard flow 3) aria-live announces breadcrumb change 4) deep-link panel focus moves to header and pressing Escape returns focus predictably.

maya singh: one more UX: when a deep link opens a compact header with an 'Open details' CTA, the CTA should be focusable and announced. Only after user action does the full panel open to avoid surprise.

jun park: final checklist: prototype update (jun), infra ticket (mike), a11y tests (sam), microcopy review (elaine), small arrival pill (maya). Anything else? :thinking_face:

elaine wu: release note blurb suggestion: 'Improved console navigation: long paths now collapse and legacy links remain supported.' short + friendly.

mike cole: filing PLAT-4510 now. Will include telemetry event deeplink_opened with origin and legacy flag.

jun park: thanks all  I'll post updated frames tomorrow and a 30s demo clip. :thumbsup:
